.²1 Sacred to Prajāpati; {#sarvadEvatyaM prIkzitaM prAjApatyamAlaBanta#}
 <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 2. 7</ls>; <ls>Mb. 12. 60. 44</ls>.
.²2 Born of Prajāpati (Brahmā); {#jahuH parigrahavrIqAM prAjApatyAstapasvinaH#} <ls>Ku. 6. 34</ls>.
.²3 Belonging to Prajāpati; {#prAjApatyopanItaM tadannaM pratyagrahInnfpaH#} <ls>R. 10. 52</ls>.

.²1 Giving away the whole of oneʼs property before entering upon the life
